name: Kiyonna
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $92 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13); hand-band
why: Plus-size women's wrap dresses, maxi dresses, evening gowns and tops, mostly $68–$228 and made in the USA, sold mainly online and at its Anaheim boutique.

quote.q: We’re in business still, after all these years, because we’ve always sold a feeling, not a product.

opview: “We’re in business still, after all these years, because we’ve always sold a feeling, not a product.” — Kim Camarella-Khanbeigi, founder, About Us, kiyonna.com

facts_read.source: brand site (About Us, Fall Edit, terms footer); Vinted catalogue; TRR designer index; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Kiyonna plus-size women's own label; EXCLUDED: items titled 'Sale!', stocked NYDJ jeans and Vikki Vi pants, gowns

doors.note: 'The Showroom at Kiyonna' is a public retail showroom at the brand's HQ in Anaheim Hills that sells the full collection, so counted as own-door. /pages/store-locator rendered no content.

fibre.sample: stratified sample of 80 of 210 own-label styles (323 feed records less jewelry, gift cards, a skincare kit, tights, test records and third-party resale — Vikki

craft_evidence.madein: ~50% (40 of 80 sampled PDPs state 'Made in the USA'; none says 'Imported')
craft_evidence.heritage: dated — founded 1996 by Kim Camarella-Khanbeigi (USC); place of making not stated
craft_evidence.reasoning: Half the sampled product pages state 'Made in the USA' and the founding story is dated (1996), but no factory, maker or mill is named and nothing on how the clothes are made is published. A country on half the range and little else is a 2.

notes.tech: Thread proposed 2 (2026-10-15): no named technical fabric on the site. Seated as proposed, pending ruling.
